units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=uCore autorebase to the edge unsigned OCI reference and reboot
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/ucore-autorebase/unverified
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/ucore-autorebase/signed
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
StandardOutput=journal+console
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rpm-ostree rebase --bypass-driver ostree-unverified-registry:ghcr.io/smores56/homelab-platform/edge@sha256:d5993873c8de0c9b96962abcd4a2e4b1d69651218ffab41f3663742913558555
ExecStart=/usr/bin/touch /etc/ucore-autorebase/unverified
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl disable ucore-unsigned-autorebase.service
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl reboot
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: ucore-unsigned-autorebase.service

ExecStart=/usr/bin/touch /etc/ucore-autorebase/signed
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl disable ucore-signed-autorebase.service
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl reboot
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: ucore-signed-autorebase.service
